races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A few newcomers from good stables but AL WATHBA and Sommood set the bar high for a race like this, with the former shading preference. Cites is perhaps the most appealing of the debutants on paper.

  1. AL WATHBA (FR)
  2. SOMMOOD
  3. CITES

races.name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is likely to develop into a match between KAINDY and Sea Brave, with the fact Roger Varian's charge has a recent outing under his belt tipping the vote his way.

  1. KAINDY (IRE)
  2. SEA BRAVE (IRE)
  3. BIG SNOOPY (FR)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
RIBENSKA's latest Southwell third is a strong piece of form so she gets the nod with cheekpieces added back from a short break. Her stablemate Ghisa has made a positive start to her handicap career and is second choice ahead of Bridget's View.

  1. RIBENSKA (IRE)
  2. GHISA (IRE)
  3. BRIDGET'S VIEW

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Quite an interesting fillies' handicap. APHRODITE SPIRIT was a cosy winner of her previous all-weather start and might be worth chancing with the Roger Teal stable in better form now than when she was last seen in mid-summer. Unexposed 3-y-os Ladykirk, Bint Kilfrush and Bintknight rate probable dangers.

  1. APHRODITE SPIRIT
  2. LADYKIRK (IRE)
  3. BINT KILFRUSH

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
ARRY UP is nicely drawn for one who races up with the pace and is taken to defy the handicapper again and land a fifth win in his last 7 starts. Aigeas scored readily over C&D when last seen at the start of July and is feared most ahead of Society Kiss, who shaped well at Windsor last time and seems likely to benefit from this step up to 6f.

  1. ARRY UP
  2. AIGEAS (FR)
  3. SOCIETY KISS

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
HOT SILK was a close second over a slightly shorter trip here last time and can go one better for in-form James Fanshawe. Traveling Man won a small-field apprentice race at Newmarket last week and rates an obvious danger off the same mark. Wolverhampton runner-up Evening Fades is next on the list for William Haggas.

  1. HOT SILK
  2. TRAVELING MAN
  3. EVENING FADES

races.name: Pump Technology Nursery
races.verdict:
PRIMAL caught the eye switched to a nursery when a fast-finishing fourth at Glorious Goodwood and can build on that effort to open his account. With his yard in fine form, he can see off the challenge of Mobadir who arrives on the back of a successful nursery debut, with Sovereigns High completing the shortlist.

  1. PRIMAL
  2. MOBADIR (IRE)
  3. SOVEREIGNS HIGH (IRE)

races.name: Bricklayers Arms Newbury EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CRUSHERMAN offered encouragement on debut when fifth at this course in April and can step forward from that first outing to get off the mark. Perfect Strike is also open to improvement with a run behind him and could be the main danger, while of the newcomers, Solar Swing appeals as a likely contender.

  1. CRUSHERMAN (IRE)
  2. PERFECT STRIKE (FR)
  3. SOLAR SWING (IRE)

races.name: Bricklayers Arms Newbury EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
With only one having had a previous race, preference is for BATTLEWORTHY, who makes plenty of appeal on paper and can add to his trainer's superb run of form. Kingdom of Kush also represents a yard going great guns at present and is next on the list, ahead of Saturn Star.

  1. BATTLEWORTHY (IRE)
  2. KINGDOM OF KUSH (IRE)
  3. SATURN STAR (IRE)

races.name: IRE Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SOMERS ISLES took the eye with how long she was on the bridle when finishing runner-up at Newmarket last month and, with improvement on the cards for her red-hot yard, she's fancied to go a place better at the expense of Starbuster, who shaped with plenty of promise first time out also and has been given time to strengthen up. Of the newcomers, Bidsta, Letter To Hermione and Bling make most appeal before the benefit of market clues.

  1. SOMERS ISLES (IRE)
  2. STARBURSTER (IRE)
  3. BIDSTA (IRE)

races.name: Gracelands Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
ACCADEMIA is a filly on the up and having been value extra considering the position she came from in a race that was far from truly run over C&D last month, Ed Walker's charge is fancied to bring up the hat-trick. Zatsgood's best form has come on all-weather, but he looks a major threat in this, with the progressive Home Hero taken to edge out Walson's Law for minor honours.

  1. ACCADEMIA
  2. ZATSGOOD
  3. HOME HERO (IRE)

races.name: Daily Racing Bet Boosts At BetVictor Handicap
races.verdict:
BOLD SHOUT made it third time lucky when bolting up at Salisbury a fortnight ago and with better to come now handicapping, Clive Cox's charge gets the verdict to follow up. Lion of Mali deserves plenty of credit for consistency, so he can give the selection most to think about, with Show Me Gold rounding off the shortlist.

  1. BOLD SHOUT (IRE)
  2. LION OF MALI
  3. SHOW ME GOLD

races.name: Sheldrake Training Limited 'Train An Apprentice' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
EMPIRICAL hasn't looked back since headgear was fitted, seeing off a next-time-out winner at Ayr last month. The hat-trick may well beckon, for all Eagles Attire rates a potential big improver now handicapping up in distance. Livemore is also open to progress.

  1. EMPIRICAL (IRE)
  2. EAGLES ATTIRE (IRE)
  3. LIVEMORE

races.name: Yorkshire Dales Distillery/EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The eye is drawn to MUGHEER on debut given the level his half-brother Shayem has achieved for connections. Shaniko and the frustrating Romidijo set a solid if unspectacular standard.

  1. MUGHEER (IRE)
  2. SHANIKO
  3. ROMIDIJO

races.name: Berber Leather Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a lot to choose between the 4 of these with some form and MOONLIGHT MELODY just about the most persuasive option despite a wider-than-ideal draw. Royale Union is feared most.

  1. MOONLIGHT MELODY
  2. ROYALE UNION (IRE)
  3. LADY GORMIRE (IRE)

races.name: Happy 50th Birthday Victoria Melling Handicap
races.verdict:
RUN THIS WAY remained in good form after winning twice in the spring and makes appeal returning from almost 3 months off. Batternburg Belle and Barmyblade have both scored over C&D this season and rate the main dangers.

  1. RUN THIS WAY
  2. BATTENBURG BELLE (IRE)
  3. BARMYBLADE (IRE)

races.name: Hats Of Yorkshire Handicap
races.verdict:
NIFFLER appeals as one who could run up a sequence for Sir Mark Prescott and is very hard to oppose under a penalty. Fairydale might pose the bggest threat ahead of Mr Withington.

  1. NIFFLER (GER)
  2. FAIRYDALE (IRE)
  3. MR WITHINGTON (FR)

races.name: Oops A Daisy Handicap
races.verdict:
FIDELIUS couldn't have gone any closer on his debut for Nigel Tinkler last time and can make amends here at the chief expense of Canon's House and Secret Mistral.

  1. FIDELIUS
  2. CANON'S HOUSE
  3. SECRET MISTRAL

races.name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
WITHOUT DELAY was denied by the narrowest of margins over C&D earlier this month and looks the most solid option ahead of Lanarra and Ridgemaster.

  1. WITHOUT DELAY (IRE)
  2. LANARRA (IRE)
  3. RIDGEMASTER (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
A few of these arrive with a question to answer so this looks a good opportunity for SUB THIRTEEN to gain a deserved success eased 1 lb on the back of a solid Lingfield fourth. Recent Lingfield victor Bridget's Baby rates the chief threat ahead of Fancy Dancer.

  1. SUB THIRTEEN
  2. BRIDGET'S BABY
  3. FANCY DANCER

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LOVELY DARK ANGEL looked very much in need of the experience and shaped well in the circumstances on her recent debut when running on late into fourth so looks the way to go here, despite holding a wide berth. The consistent My Maria rates much the biggest threat, although she again could have to settle for second, unless one of the newcomers proves above average, with Reddy rating the pick.

  1. LOVELY DARK ANGEL (IRE)
  2. MY MARIA (IRE)
  3. REDDY

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
CURRAHEE didn't enjoy the rub of the green when fourth at Newmarket last time and could prove the answer to this tight-knit sprint off a handy-looking mark. Diamondinthedark rates a big threat though with the form of her recent Ffos Las second working out well, while Night Mission and Campenaerts also need factoring in.

  1. CURRAHEE (IRE)
  2. DIAMONDINTHEDARK
  3. NIGHT MISSION (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap
races.verdict:
BOILERMAKER looked to have something left in the tank when going in for the first time at Sandown and can defy a 3 lb weights rise here. Both V Power (second choice) and The Craftymaster have excellent records round here and seem sure to have a big say too though.

  1. BOILERMAKER (FR)
  2. V POWER
  3. THE CRAFTYMASTER

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
SPACEAGE LOVE SONG rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to gain a second C&D success here at the chief expense of in-form duo Fighting Poet and Smoker Bellamy who can chase home Michael Bell's 3-y-o in that order.

  1. SPACEAGE LOVE SONG (IRE)
  2. FIGHTING POET (IRE)
  3. SMOKER BELLAMY (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
BOOK OF LIFE has slipped in the weights and wasn't seen to best effect when seventh at Newcastle last time so edges the vote from the reliable On Key who rates a big threat in his bid for a second win here. C&D scorer Manton Road is also firmly in the picture.

  1. BOOK OF LIFE
  2. ON KEY
  3. MANTON ROAD

races.name: Spillers ULCA Power Cubes Handicap Stakes (0-60) - Arab Race
Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Claiming Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROCKY'S HOWYA has been prolific in claiming hurdles this season and Declan Queally's veteran can add another to his collection at the expense of Oh So Charming, who ended a long losing run returned to a claimer at Sligo earlier in the month. Howdoyalikeherhome was fourth in that race, and he can edge out Eastern Wind for third.

  1. ROCKY'S HOWYA (IRE)
  2. OH SO CHARMING
  3. HOWDOYALIKEHERHOME (IRE)

races.name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
THESILVERBRIDLE can provide John McConnell with a second successive winner in this race. Chantilly Wings and What's New are likely to provide the main opposition.

  1. THESILVERBRIDLE (IRE)
  2. CHANTILLY WINGS (IRE)
  3. WHATS NEW (IRE)

races.name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
CORNAROYA ROCCO shaped as though this trip would really suit when dropping away late on over 23f at Ballinrobe last time and can capitalise on a handy-looking mark to gain a first success. Steps In The Sand rates a big threat though now she goes up in distance, while Hatfield Hammer and Goin' can also have a say in this open handicap.

  1. CORNAROYA ROCCO (IRE)
  2. STEPS IN THE SAND (IRE)
  3. HATFIELD HAMMER (IRE)

races.name: Bective Stud, Hotel & Tea Rooms Mullacurry Cup Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A few with chances but THEFLYINGBEE rates the pick at these weights and is fancied to gain a deserved success and bag a second C&D success. Red Glory heads the list of dangers on the back of a good recent Galway fourth ahead of Camlin Park and Liam Swagger.

  1. THEFLYINGBEE (IRE)
  2. RED GLORY (IRE)
  3. CAMLIN PARK (IRE)

races.name: PANDA Mares Hurdle
races.verdict:
FASTNET CRYSTAL has made a positive start over hurdles, building on her debut success when runner-up in listed novice at the Galway Festival, and she can continue her progress to resume winning ways. Easter Bonnet left her previous efforts over hurdles behind when opening her account at Cork and is feared most, ahead of Daboya.

  1. FASTNET CRYSTAL (IRE)
  2. EASTER BONNET (FR)
  3. DABOYA (IRE)

races.name: John Purfield Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LET IT SETTLE had an excuse at Cork last time and might be worth chancing having returned to the same mark as when second to a next-time-out scorer there in July. Last-time-out Cork scorer Chesterbaylad heads the many dangers along with Lunar Landscape and Convincing. Direct Approach is an unexposed handicap newcomer from a top stable, while Masego tackles his first handicap hurdle on the back of a good spell on the Flat.

  1. LET IT SETTLE (IRE)
  2. CHESTERBAYLAD (IRE)
  3. LUNAR LANDSCAPE

races.name: John Purfield Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SYOSSET is knocking on the door for a first success, so he appeals as the most solid option with first-time cheekpieces added to his usual hood. Tropical Twist seemed to find the race coming too soon just 2 days on from her Wexford victory at Downpatrick and is worth another chance, with Cinnabar Moth tentative pick of the remainder.

  1. SYOSSET (IRE)
  2. TROPICAL TWIST (IRE)
  3. CINNABAR MOTH (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
MYLUCKYMAKER was value for finishing further clear of the third on her recent yard debut having lost at least 1½ lengths when stumbling over 2f out, so she's worth another chance to open her account. Blue Trix is of obvious interest on debut for a top stable, while Ifuknowuknow contested a notably warm race at Leopardstown when last seen and shouldn't be taken lightly with his slightly longer trip in his favour. Thranduil is another debutant to note.

  1. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  2. BLUE TRIX (IRE)
  3. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)

races.name: Prix Holiday Inn Express Arcachon - La Teste (px A. Boingneres) Maiden Stakes
French Arabian Breeders' Challenge - Poulains Stakes (arab Group 2)
Prix Ds Automobiles - Ds Store Arcachon (px Jc. Guerin) Claiming Stakes
French Arabian Breeders' Challenge - Pouliches Stakes (arab Group 2)
Prix Mc Donald's Bassin D'arcachon Handicap
Prix De La Risle Handicap Hurdle
Grand Steeple-chase De La Ville De Deauville Listed Handicap Chase
Prix Des Benevoles Du Littoral Olonnois - Monte
